# FitPlanCoach

> Personalized meal plans, adaptive workouts, and progress tracking — tailored to your body, goals, schedule, and budget.

FitPlanCoach is a subscription fitness coaching service. It generates personalized meal plans and workout schedules from a short onboarding profile (body metrics, activity level, goals, preferences, equipment, availability), then tracks weight, workouts, and adherence over time. Free tier available; paid tiers add weekly regeneration and advanced tracking. Payments accepted via PayPal (international) and QRIS (Indonesia), manually reviewed. 30-day money-back guarantee.
